problems.stem: Your page loads in the browser but has no <title> and no <h1>. On the four-item publish checklist, what is the verdict?
options: FAIL on Page title and Real heading, even though it renders.
PASS, because browsers ignore missing tags.
It cannot load without a title.
problems.explanation: Rendering is not the bar; missing title and heading are checklist failures even when the page displays.

problems.stem: Which line correctly makes 'My Teacher-AI Dialogue Project' the main heading?
problems.explanation: An h1 is a real heading element; big text or a title tag in the head is not the page heading.

problems.stem: The AI suggests adding a flashy background color, but your link still reads link with no href. What is the strongest move?
options: Add the background color first; it looks more finished.
Reject the decoration for now and fix the empty href so the link points to the real file.
Delete the link so the color stands out.
problems.explanation: The publish checklist values a working link over decoration; fixing the href is the substantive move.

problems.stem: After pushing to GitHub Pages, what confirms the publish actually worked?
options: The file exists on your laptop.
Opening the live URL and seeing the title in the tab, the heading rendered, and the link downloading the real file.
The AI said it looked good.
problems.explanation: Verification means loading the published URL and checking each checklist item live, not trusting the local copy.
